description: This file defines the 'Ip' model class for the OpenCart platform, responsible for checking if an IP address is associated with fraudulent activity in the order process.

classes.name: Ip
classes.description: A model class extending the OpenCart system engine, used for fraud IP checking logic.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if the IP address related to an order is flagged for fraud and returns an associated order status ID or zero.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves all entries from the 'fraud_ip' table matching a specific IP address.
